background: Shawbrook is a UK specialist lender owned by private equity, funded by retail and business savings and lending on buy-to-let and specialist residential mortgages, commercial property, and to smaller companies through asset and structured finance.
synthesis: None of the three agencies rates the bank. Capital is mixed against UK mid-sized banks: CET1 of 13.0% is in the bottom quarter, while leverage of 8.7% is in the top quarter. Liquidity is on the weak side, with LCR of 157% below the peer median and NSFR of 126% in the bottom quarter. The trend is the point: since 31 Dec 2023 LCR has fallen 154 points and NSFR 20 points, so a large liquidity surplus has been run down, while CET1 has been flat and leverage has risen 0.5 points; the flagged news, on 5 Aug 2026, is a strong rise in first-half profit.
